scope: Country Iran; documented U.S. or joint U.S.-Israel action, including lethal incidents reported in a U.S. operation context. The April 5 pilot-rescue record documents operation context without explicit strike-actor attribution. Shared dyad membership, U.S. commentary, or sanctions alone are insufficient. Records with no documented U.S. role in the reviewed evidence are withheld, not proven Israel-only.
post_selection: Preserves the original 87 reviewed posts. Later original text posts match Iran/Iranian, Tehran, Hormuz, or Khamenei; quotes and reblogs excluded. Text-only analysis does not read attached media.
change_notes: Added UCDP 640608, August 30, Larak Island: explicit U.S. attack attribution; best fatalities 2, low 2, high 3.
Restored July 30 (637563 and 637567), previously omitted because its post windows were empty.
Existing 47 event IDs preserved; official fields reconciled by persistent id against Jan-Jun and July sources.
Kept original 87 scores after checking source text equivalence apart from whitespace; scored 3 new posts with the same six descriptions and hypothesis template.
August 31 archive coverage ends 08:09 EDT; its after-window is displayed and excluded from aggregate means.
No-post windows are absent observations, not numeric zero scores.
Event-day posts cannot establish advance warning: UCDP provides calendar dates without intraday timestamps.

Selection review added UCDP 629301, April 5, Boyer-Ahmad: five reported deaths during the U.S. pilot-rescue operation. Strike actor unspecified in the AFP report. April 5 already exists, so date groups, post windows and rhetoric means are unchanged. This addition also raises the selected same-day fatality total for April 5 from 5 to 10.

upstream_quality_flags.625182: Official Jan-Jun source has low=best=2417 and high=2401. Preserve source values and flag the inconsistency. This cumulative multi-day record is excluded from same-day fatality severity.

file_checksum_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with LF line endings; portable across Git checkouts.

highlight_key.yellow: Dates used in original post analysis

reference_source_pool.scope: Country Iran; UCDP conflict_new_id 16905; official Candidate releases January–June, July, and August 2026.
reference_source_pool.selection: Current decisions for all 80 records are documented in ucdp-selection-review.json. Reasons describe the October 11 review, not undocumented historical exclusions. Unverified U.S. involvement is not proof of absence.

selection_review.basis: Project selection decisions, not official UCDP classifications. All 80 supplied headline/source fields reviewed; full AFP reports additionally checked for 629301 and 629300. Original per-record exclusion rationales were not logged. These are current decisions, not reconstructed historical reasons. Other full articles have not been exhaustively reviewed; unverified U.S. involvement is not proof of absence.

extract_text_normalization: Selected CSV text uses LF line endings and ISO calendar dates. Source words and numerical values are preserved. Unmodified official CSV files retain original bytes; the source-pool CSV retains the original source-field strings.
